items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a chance to do a picture with Cab Calloway called "Sensations of 45”

ctx.x: Yes. So, when did you leave the Chicago area? Did you go alone or with a band?
I left the Chicago area in 1944. I got a chance to do a picture with Cab Calloway called "Sensations of 45” and my mother went with me.
